UniQR version, and whether it is the downloaded file or run from the source:

Operating system:

The log can help, but it may contain links you scanned. Look through it and paste
only what you are happy to share. Where it is:
- Windows: `%LOCALAPPDATA%\UniQR\uniqr.log`
- Linux: `~/.local/state/uniqr/uniqr.log`
- macOS: `~/Library/Logs/UniQR/uniqr.log`
